Markets.title: US stocks: S&P 500, Nasdaq reach record closing highs as focus pivots to earnings
Markets.summary: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq reached record closing highs, driven by stabilizing crude prices and easing Treasury yields. Investor focus is now shifting toward the upcoming third-quarter earnings reports.

Markets.title: Kalshi launches perpetual futures tied to US 500 stock index
Markets.summary: Kalshi has launched a new perpetual futures contract tied to the US 500 stock index. The contract allows traders to hold long or short positions indefinitely without rolling over.

Markets.title: SAP to acquire workforce data firm TechWolf
Markets.summary: SAP plans to acquire workforce data analysis firm TechWolf by the fourth quarter. The acquisition aims to help SAP better understand customer workforce skills and needs regarding artificial intelligence.

Markets.title: Gold industry expects price rise to $5,013 an ounce over 12 months
Markets.summary: London Bullion Market Association officials predict gold prices will rise to $5,013 per ounce over the next year. They also expect silver, platinum, and palladium prices to increase due to rising interest rate worries and geopolitical strains.

Markets.title: US EIA lifts Brent forecast to $98 as Iran war tightens global supplies
Markets.summary: The US Energy Information Administration raised its 2026 Brent crude price forecast to $98 a barrel due to tightening global supplies from the Iran war. Retail diesel prices are expected to remain high initially before gradually declining to about $4.50 in 2027.

Markets.title: Fed plans bank-supervision overhaul to strengthen accountability, says Vice Chair Michelle Bowman
Markets.summary: The Federal Reserve is reorganizing its bank supervision system into five geographic regions led by regional leaders to increase accountability. This restructuring addresses concerns from the Silicon Valley Bank collapse and includes a review of regulatory asset thresholds.

Geo-Political.title: US death row inmate Christa Pike conscious after failed execution, lawyers say
Geo-Political.summary: Lawyers for 50-year-old US death row inmate Christa Pike stated that she is conscious and receiving medical care in a hospital following a failed execution. She remains handcuffed while being treated for critical medical conditions.

Geo-Political.title: Tear gas in Paris and Marseille as school protests grow across France
Geo-Political.summary: Teenagers in Paris and Marseille held protests demanding increased resources for schools and an end to alleged police repression. French police responded by deploying tear gas as the demonstrations grew across the country.

Geo-Political.title: Former German spy chief arrested for espionage and treason
Geo-Political.summary: Former German spy chief August Hanning has been arrested for espionage and treason. He is accused of obtaining classified information for a foreign power.

Geo-Political.title: Ship sinks and crew missing after Black Sea drone attack
Geo-Political.summary: A ship sank and its crew went missing following a drone attack in the Black Sea. The identity of the attackers remains unclear amid intensified Russian strikes during the war against Ukraine.

Geo-Political.title: Lawyer for one of Cornell 7 calls for special prosecutor to be removed over previous comments
Geo-Political.summary: A lawyer representing one of the Cornell 7 is asking for New York Attorney General Letitia James to be removed from investigating rape allegations. The lawyer argues that previous comments made by James about the case disqualify her from acting as a special prosecutor.

Geo-Political.title: Finland orders halt to work on two Google data centres
Geo-Political.summary: Finland has ordered a halt to construction work on two planned Google data centres. The suspension was issued following local concerns regarding forest clearance for the projects.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An online course creator recently discovered that ChatGPT recommended their WordPress SaaS course as the top result without any paid advertising. This experiment highlights a shift in organic traffic generation from traditional SEO to AI optimization (AIO).

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools That Will Transform Your Content Creation in 2025
AI & Tech.summary: Artificial intelligence tools have become essential for digital creators looking to stay competitive in 2025. A new guide highlights the top 10 AI platforms designed to revolutionize and simplify the content creation process.

AI & Tech.title: LimeWire AI Studio Review 2023: Details, Pricing & Features
AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has evolved into a generative AI platform that allows users to create digital content. The tool also provides features for creators to share and monetize their work.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools in 2023 That Will Make Your Life Easier
AI & Tech.summary: This article highlights the top 10 artificial intelligence tools of 2023 used across various industries to drive innovation. These advanced applications are designed to automate repetitive tasks, improve workflows, and increase overall productivity.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Content Generator & Writer Tools in 2022
AI & Tech.summary: This article evaluates the top 10 AI content generator and writer tools available in 2022. It aims to help readers choose the right software to efficiently create engaging and relevant content for their audiences.

AI & Tech.title: Beginner Guide to CJ Affiliate (Commission Junction) in 2022
AI & Tech.summary: This beginner's guide explains how to use the CJ Affiliate network to earn money. It also highlights top CJ affiliate programs and alternative platforms.

Data & Insights.title: GST Council aims to ease compliance, expedite refunds, curb frequent rate tweaks
Data & Insights.summary: The GST Council meeting led by Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman will consider a proposal to reduce GST registration time for most businesses from over three weeks to three working days. The meeting also aims to ease compliance, expedite refunds, and curb frequent tax rate changes.

Data & Insights.title: World Bank raises India FY27 growth forecast to 7.1% on resilient demand, exports
Data & Insights.summary: The World Bank raised India's fiscal year 2027 growth forecast to 7.1% due to resilient domestic demand and exports. Strong industrial activity, investments, and potential AI productivity boosts are expected to offset risks from higher oil prices and weaker rainfall.

Data & Insights.title: Govt plans to expand services index to cover 80% of sector output
Data & Insights.summary: India's statistics ministry plans to include education, healthcare, and defence in its monthly services index. This expansion will increase the index's coverage from about 60% to roughly 80% of the sector's gross value added.

Data & Insights.title: Iran war: Shell sees Middle East oil flows at 80% as Saudi Aramco warns inventories may take 2 years to rebuild
Data & Insights.summary: Shell's CEO reports that Middle East oil exports have recovered to about 80% of their pre-conflict levels. Meanwhile, Saudi Aramco warns that it could take up to two years to rebuild depleted oil inventories.

Data & Insights.title: Mint Explainer | Why the RBI looks set to hike rates
Data & Insights.summary: The Reserve Bank of India is widely expected to raise the repo rate. This expected hike is driven by rising inflation, higher oil prices, and global monetary tightening.

India.title: Guns, Political Killings, Attacks On Cops: Punjab's Arms Trail Before Polls
India.summary: Punjab faces growing law-and-order and security challenges ahead of elections due to the easy availability of sophisticated illegal weapons. This influx of illegal arms is linked to incidents involving guns, political killings, and attacks on police officers.

India.title: What Happened Near Poll Body Office? Inside Story Of Opposition March
India.summary: Samajwadi Party MPs wearing red caps and scarves led an opposition march while holding red slogan placards. The protest took place near the election body's office.

India.title: Woman, Boyfriend Kill Husband In Meerut, Phone Chat Exposes Plot
India.summary: A 27-year-old beautician named Ilma and her boyfriend murdered her 30-year-old husband, Talib, in Meerut after four years of marriage. Investigators uncovered the plot through chat messages found on a mobile phone.

India.title: Rahul Gandhi Had Made A Batman Quip. His Party Made Him Caped Crusader
India.summary: In August, posters depicting Rahul Gandhi as Batman were displayed near the Congress headquarters and in central Delhi. The promotional material followed a previous quip made by Gandhi referencing the comic book superhero.

India.title: 'Permanently Shifted' Voters Nearly Half of 13.39-Crore Flagged Entries
India.summary: Nearly half of the 13.39 crore flagged voter entries identified by the Election Commission of India involve individuals who have permanently shifted residences. The Election Commission stated that these draft figures are not final and that the claims-and-objections process will prevent wrongful exclusions.

India.title: Rahul, Priyanka Gandhi Detained During Sit-In Against Gyanesh Kumar. Released
India.summary: Opposition leaders Rahul and Priyanka Gandhi were detained by police on Tuesday during a protest march toward the Election Commission headquarters. The INDIA alliance members were demonstrating against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar before being subsequently released.

General.title: Three arrested after raid on gang accused of helping migrants pretend to be gay to get asylum
General.summary: Home Office immigration enforcement officers arrested three people accused of running a gang that helped migrants pretend to be gay to secure asylum. The suspects allegedly charged migrants up to £4,500 each for the fabricated evidence.

General.title: Watch: Police raid on gang behind fake gay asylum claims
General.summary: Police arrested members of a criminal gang following a BBC investigation that exposed fake gay asylum claims. The investigation revealed that advisers and law firms were helping migrants pretend to be gay to secure asylum.

General.title: US death row inmate Christa Pike conscious after failed execution, lawyers say
General.summary: Christa Pike, a 50-year-old death row inmate, is receiving critical medical care in a hospital after a failed execution attempt. Her lawyers stated on Tuesday that she remains conscious while handcuffed during her treatment.

General.title: Tear gas in Paris and Marseille as school protests grow across France
General.summary: Teenagers in Paris and Marseille held protests demanding increased school resources and an end to police repression. Police used tear gas as these demonstrations grew across France.

General.title: British national arrested in connection with RAF Fairford incident
General.summary: A British national has been arrested in connection with an incident near RAF Fairford last month. This marks the seventh arrest made regarding the security breach at the military base.

General.title: Asos confirms hackers sent 'unauthorised' notification to app users
General.summary: Online retailer Asos confirmed that hackers sent an unauthorized notification to users through its mobile app on Tuesday. The incident caused alarm among customers before the company acknowledged the security breach.
